annotations.title: Request a review with local tests

description: Like request_review, but also sends excerpts of the tests of the files the pull request changes, read from your local checkout, so the review sees them. Only when local_context_status says enabled. Push first: head_sha is the commit you read at, and if the pull request's head is another commit nothing is queued (head_moved). For each changed source file, up to 3 test files named after it (test_foo.py, foo_test.go, foo.test.ts, foo.spec.js, FooTest.java, or foo.* in a tests directory); each item is {path, start_line: 1, end_line, sha: head_sha, text}: the file's first lines exactly as committed, at most 200 lines an item, 2000 lines and 150000 bytes in all. Never send secrets or files that are not tests; MergeSafe checks every excerpt against the commit.

addons.description: Optional add-ons; leave out to use the repository's own setting.

evidence.description: The test excerpts, as the tool's description lists.

tier.description: Optional review level: essential, strong or ultra (budget, the older name, still works and is what responses say). Leave it out to use the repository's own setting.
